CU Design Build Fly

Overview

I’ve been part of CU DBF since my freshman year, progressing through three roles across three years: Mechanical and Structural Subteam Member (2023–2024), M&S Subteam Co-Lead (2024–2025), and Full Team Co-Lead (2025–2026). I’d like to showcase both my experience leading the team and the technical projects I’ve completed for the team. This page provides a brief overview of what DBF is and then showcases my work below.

The Competition

The AIAA Design Build Fly competition challenges collegiate teams to design, build, and fly a radio-controlled aircraft in a series of missions and following a series of design constraints released each fall. The competition is scored based on both flight mission performance and a technical report, providing students with the challenge of not only creating a high-performance aircraft but also substantiating it in a 60-page technical report.
